title: NS Queue with Medtronic MMT-754
body:
In the last month or so I am having NSv3 queues and they come down to a normal number only if I restart AAPS or if I click the refresh button in Medtronic tab. I also noticed that when I initialy connect the pump to AAPS via Rileylink, it connects andf reads pages 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 i think, but when I press the refresh buton later, it refreshes only pages 1 and 2. 
I have the feeling that my AAPS inst working 100% as it should and in the last months i have much more hipoglucemias than before. Usualy I have a negative basal and I have a positive bolus. 
Example: 
Bolus: 0,63U,
Basa: -2,15U
IOB: -1,52U and my GUK was 2.9 mmol/l

Is there a was to fix this problem with my MMT-754 pump and NSv3?

Also I have more "Basal profile in pump updated" messages than ussusal.

I am using AAPS ver 4.0.0-dev-a

comments.body:
Answer to History pages... When you start AAPS, full history is downloaded (for last 3 days I think). When you click Refresh only new History pages will be downloaded. 

Not sure why Refresh button on Medtronic tab should have anything to do with NS though...

> Answer to History pages... When you start AAPS, full history is downloaded (for last 3 days I think). When you click Refresh only new History pages will be downloaded.
> 
> Not sure why Refresh button on Medtronic tab should have anything to do with NS though...

Once before I got a message (#4973) from Miloš and he said the queue appears because of the Medtronic comunication? 
He said: 

"this is only temporary state until history is read from pump. medtronic specific
no need to fix it"

and 

"medtronic difference is that loading pump history takes time"

I am looking right now and the queue if 0 (as it shpould be), but arrounf 10 o clock today the nimber was 43...

Am I the only one with this strange behavour? As I said, a month or 2 ago I didn't have these issues...
